title: Imaging-anchored Multiomics in Cardiovascular Disease: Integrating Cardiac Imaging, Bulk, Single-cell, and Spatial Transcriptomics
abstract: arXiv:2601.07871v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cardiovascular disease arises from interactions between inherited risk, molecular programmes, and tissue-scale remodelling that are observed clinically through imaging. Health systems now routinely generate large volumes of cardiac MRI, CT and echocardiography together with bulk, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, yet these data are still analysed in separate pipelines. This review examines joint representations that link cardiac imaging phenotypes to transcriptomic and spatially resolved molecular states. An imaging-anchored perspective is adopted in which echocardiography, cardiac MRI and CT define a spatial phenotype of the heart, and bulk, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics provide cell-type- and location-specific molecular context. translated_title: 心血管疾病中以影像为锚点的多组学研究：整合心脏影像、bulk转录组、单细胞与空间转录组学
translated_abstract: 心血管疾病源于遗传风险、分子程序与组织尺度重塑之间的相互作用，这些过程在临床上通过影像学手段被观察。目前医疗系统常规产生大量心脏MRI、CT和超声心动图数据，以及bulk转录组、单细胞和空间转录组数据，然而这些数据仍在各自独立的分析流程中处理。本综述探讨了将心脏影像表型与转录组及空间分辨分子状态相联系的联合表示方法。本文采用以影像为锚点的视角，即由超声心动图、心脏MRI和CT定义心脏的空间表型，而bulk、单细胞和空间转录组则提供细胞类型特异与位置特异的分子背景。文中首先总结了这些模态的生物学与技术特性，并概述了各自相应的表示学习策略。多模态融合方法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本综述提出以心脏影像为锚点的多组学整合框架，将超声心动图、心脏MRI和CT所定义的心脏空间表型，与bulk、单细胞及空间转录组提供的细胞类型和位置特异的分子背景相融合，从而打破数据孤岛、实现心血管疾病的多模态联合分析。
en_tdlr: This review proposes an imaging-anchored multiomics framework that integrates cardiac imaging (echocardiography, MRI, CT) with bulk, single-cell, and spatial transcriptomics to jointly characterize cardiovascular disease across spatial phenotype and molecular context.
